question_text: Describe the difference between the Reservation class and an individual reservation object in a booking program.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: The class defines the attributes and methods shared by reservations. An object is one concrete instance with its own state, such as one customer’s dates and rate. Many objects can be created from the same definition.
